comment_box: I am writing to express my strong opposition to removing abortion access for veterans and their families. Restricting abortion access will only put veterans and their families at greater risk. Additionally, I feel that restricting abortion access infringes on personal freedoms that I understand the military has historically defended. Given the rates of sexual assault within the military, this proposed policy is shameful.
